specs.title: SPDK/DPDK Environment Component with VFIO Device Iteration

drifted.spec_text: Discovers 100% of available VFIO-bound devices matching /sys/bus/pci/drivers/vfio-pci; US1/Clarifications say 'All SPDK-supported device types bound to VFIO (NVMe, virtio-blk, etc.)'.
drifted.actual: enumerate_devices enumerates only the NVMe PCI driver (spdk_pci_get_driver("nvme")); non-NVMe vfio-pci devices (e.g. virtio-blk) are never discovered. FR-006 already narrows to NVMe-only, so this is also an internal spec contradiction.
drifted.location: components/spdk-env/src/env.rs:164-181; spec.md SC-001 (line 174), US1 narrative (line 22), Clarifications (line 12)

not_implemented: FR-015: skip in-use devices with per-device warning, return only successfully probed devices (spec-acknowledged 'Future: not yet implemented'; enumerate_devices uses a non-attach callback per FR-006, so no probe/claim step exists to skip)

resolved_since_last_run.note: spdk-sys -> lib/spdk-sys, component-framework -> lib/component-framework. Backfilled 2026-08-20; verified present this run (tasks.md:10 note + lib/spdk-sys paths; spec.md:6 bracketed note). spec.md:99,188 are crate-name refs, still valid.

conflicts.description: FR-006 (NVMe-only) contradicts SC-001 / User Story 1 narrative / Clarifications (all SPDK-supported device types). Tracked as the SC-001 drift item above; resolution is a scope decision.
